title: Chapter 41
text:
"Why don't you give it a try?"

Lambert was clearly a man of action. Following Han Xiao's request, he removed the mask of the masked man, only to discover that there were no facial features under the mask. The other two were shocked to see that the masked man had no facial features.

"This … this isn't a human!"

Lin Yao was horrified. She lifted everyone's masks and saw that they were all faceless men!

At that moment, the faceless man that Han Xiao had pointed out started to change. A black spider tattoo slowly appeared on his face, and his facial features gradually became more prominent. He looked exactly like Black Spider, and his wounds started to heal. Then, the eyelids of the 'corpse' started to move, as if he was about to wake up.

"Crush his head!" Han Xiao's tone was cold.

Lambert immediately shot the faceless man.

Han Xiao repeated this process over and over again, and every time, he would be able to find the faceless man in advance. Li Ya Lin and Lin Yao were shocked, but they suppressed their doubts and followed Han Xiao's instructions obediently.

Although they did not know how Han Xiao knew about Black Spider's secret, it did not stop them from trusting Han Xiao's judgment.

When it came to the last faceless man, Han Xiao said, "Don't kill him. Break his limbs."

No one objected. The three did as they were told.

The last faceless man was now Black Spider. He opened his eyes in shock. "How did you know about my Esper ability?!"

This was Black Spider's Esper ability!

Every once in a while, Black Spider could create a faceless man's clone. The clone had no intelligence. As long as it was within a certain range of Black Spider, it would follow orders. Otherwise, it would fall into a deep sleep.

Every clone was equivalent to Black Spider's second life. He could constantly be reborn in the nearest clone. As long as there was a clone, he would not die.

This Esper ability was not offensive, but it was extremely resilient. It was like a cockroach that could not be killed. It was extremely difficult to deal with. Black Spider's Esper ability had changed his life essence. His physical body could no longer restrain him. Black Spider's Esper body had become a form of mental energy that lived in the clones he created.

As long as there was a clone, he would not be killed by physical means!

Black Spider was in disbelief. He had never revealed his ability to anyone. This was the secret that he relied on for a living. How did it get leaked?

Could it be that he had been too active recently, causing someone to vaguely guess his ability?

Han Xiao looked at Black Spider's shocked expression on the screen and chuckled. If it had been some unknown Boss, he might not have remembered it. However, in his previous life, Black Spider was famous for being difficult to kill. It had left a deep impression on him.

At this time, Black Spider's development of his ability was still very low, so it was the best time to deal with him. With Han Xiao's insight, he could see that this ability had a lot of value, but Black Spider had died early in his previous life, so he couldn't develop this ability to a higher level.

You ask how he died?

Although the Black Spider's ability was difficult to deal with, it was still far from being unsolvable. As long as the Black Spider's soul was crushed into powder on a spiritual level, the Black Spider would be completely dead. However, as mentioned before, there were very few Psychic Ability users in Blue Star, so the players could not kill Black Spider at all. Therefore, Black Spider was listed in the "Hardest Boss to Kill in Version 1.0" list by Blue Star players.

Well, Black Spider himself thought so too. Then, he met Hella, and … there was no more after that.

There were all kinds of strange abilities in the Esper class, and it was different from the other four Super classes. It required the awakening of the Gene Potion to change class, and only after that would one need to learn the Esper class knowledge. Every player only had one chance to use the Gene Potion. Once it failed, the account would never be able to change class, and the success rate of the awakening depended on the type of potion used.

Your hunch was right. This thing was rumored to be a pay-to-win item in the game store, and it cost money.

The Gene Potion with the lowest success rate cost as high as 398 Euros, and the one with the highest success rate, [Deluxe Perfect Gene Awakening Fluid], cost 4999 Euros. Furthermore, the highest success rate was only 18%, and it did not take into account the potential level of the awakened Esper.

Sixty percent of the players who could afford the potion would grit their teeth and try to see if they could awaken their Esper. The game company made a lot of money from this.

Han Xiao had also gritted his teeth and bought the potion in his previous life. However, with his character, the results were unquestionable. In the end, he came to the conclusion that Esper players were either lucky or just rich.

Black Spider quickly calmed down. "I have countless doppelgangers. Even if you destroy this body, you still won't be able to kill me. On the other hand, even if you hide at the ends of the earth, you won't be able to live a single day of peace. Sooner or later, I'll break your necks with my own hands!"

Lambert raised his hand and was about to shoot when Han Xiao hurriedly stopped him. "Just say what I say," he said to Li Ya Lin.

Therefore, Li Ya Lin followed Han Xiao's instructions through the earpiece and mimicked him. She put on a mysterious expression and said, "Countless clones? Stop bluffing. You can only have fifty doppelgangers at most! There are ten corpses here. You can leave the rest of your doppelgangers in hiding places all over the world. Those doppelgangers are your trump cards. "

Black Spider's eyes widened in disbelief. It was understandable that someone had guessed the basic characteristics of his Esper ability, but the specifics were his deepest secrets. No one else could have known about them!

Someone had completely figured out his Esper ability!

Who? Who could it be?

Could it be … an Esper with the ability to read minds?

"As long as this doppelganger of yours is alive, you won't be able to be reborn. We can't kill you, but we can lock you up for life!"

Black Spider's expression changed. He wanted to bite off his tongue, but Lambert was faster and dislocated his lower jaw.

Black Spider couldn't die. He glared at Li Ya Lin in shock and anger.

"Finally scared, huh?" Li Ya Lin saw Black Spider's shocked expression and knew that Han Xiao was right.

The three of them looked at each other and had the same thought.

Who was Han Xiao?

Why did Division 13 treat his identity as a secret?

Why did he know such a secret?

…

Reinforcements arrived soon after. They put Black Spider in a restraining suit and took him away.

At the same time, Han Xiao received a notification that he had completed his mission.

Level E Mission [Black Spider] completed. You have received 5,000 EXP.

Hidden Requirement: 'Capture Black Spider' completed. Please select the special reward: 40000 EXP/Spirit Stabilizer.

The Spirit Stabilizer was used to increase one's mental resistance to a certain extent. It was a mechanical device that was used against the magical civilization.

Blue Star didn't have many psychic or magical professions, and there weren't many psychic Espers either. Han Xiao naturally chose the more practical 40,000 EXP.

Hella? He probably wouldn't have to face her for a long time.

You have received 40000 EXP.

"Not bad," Han Xiao said happily.

…

The three of them returned to the Covert Operations Department. The moment they entered, Li Ya Lin rushed over and asked curiously, "How did you know about Black Spider's Esper ability?"

Han Xiao smiled mysteriously. "Give me a million, and I'll tell you."

Li Ya Lin was immediately discouraged.

"By the way, how are you going to deal with Black Spider?"

Lin Yao scratched his head. "I heard that the higher-ups are going to send him to Bell of Death Island Prison. He'll have to wear a restraining suit twenty-four hours a day, and he'll be fed liquid food to sustain his life. He won't be able to die even if he wants to."

The Bell of Death Island Prison was a super prison built by the Six Nations. It was isolated in the sea, and there was no way to escape. The people locked up there were all extremely evil people, super criminals, wanderers, warlords, experts and leaders of underground forces, and so on.

Once they were on the island, it was tantamount to sounding the death knell for life. They would lose their freedom forever. There was no other way to leave other than death. This was the meaning of Bell of Death Island.

Han Xiao was very satisfied with this decision. Black Spider's Esper ability was indeed very troublesome. If they were targeted by a lunatic who couldn't be killed, there would be a lot of trouble in the future.

The first mission was a perfect success, and the team had a slight tacit understanding. After saying goodbye to each other, they prepared to go back to their own homes.

At this time, Feng Jun walked over with a helpless look on his face.

"The Internal Affairs Department wants you to go through the investigation."

Han Xiao saw that his expression was not right and asked, "Hasn't my entry into the bureau already been approved?"

"The Internal Affairs Department has applied for a second investigation. Erm, this is their reasonable authority, and the upper echelons have no reason to object. Plus, you know that your previous identity is more sensitive."

Feng Jun lowered his voice and said, "The upper echelons have two opinions about you. The Intelligence Department, the Logistics Department, and the rest of the conservatives are more inclined to cooperate with you. However, the hardliners led by the Internal Affairs Department don't think so. I'm afraid they will drag you down."

Han Xiao understood. Indeed, where there were people, there was competition.

…

After arriving at the Internal Affairs Department, Han Xiao's height and weight were checked, and he was brought to an interrogation room to be investigated by the Internal Affairs Department's inspector alone.

"Name."

"Han Xiao."

"Gender."

"Female."

The veins on the inspector's forehead bulged, and he decided to bear with it.

"Age."

"Thirty … Oh no, thirty-one."

The inspector slammed the table and shouted, "Be more cooperative!"

Han Xiao said casually, "Don't ask about gender and age. You don't care about that in the first place. Can't you just skip to the background check?"

The inspector snorted angrily, "Continue, family."

"I'm an orphan. I have no family."

"Where were you born?"

"Buzhou Mountain."

"Nonsense, we didn't check your birth record!"

Sure enough, no one in this world could accept this.

Han Xiao smacked his lips, "Ask your upper echelons."

Of course, the upper echelons would not reveal his confidential information to the ordinary members. This investigation was just a formality. The Internal Affairs Department just wanted to warn or disgust him.

The inspector listened to the instructions in the earpiece and did not continue to ask. He held back his anger and began the psychological evaluation.

The psychological evaluation questions were all describing some situations and asking Han Xiao to make a choice. After he answered randomly, the inspector sealed the information and handed it to the upper echelons. The investigation was over.

The inspector suddenly said coldly, "The Internal Affairs Department is watching you at all times. Don't let us catch you."

"So you mean you can't do anything to me now." Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, turned around and patted the inspector's butt and left happily.
